data.decision: Before filing any task or bug: (1) search existing tasks/bugs for duplicates or closable overlaps; (2) check what is already planned; (3) identify reusable/extensible core modules; (4) reuse prior research/best-practice, never re-derive; (5) ask the operator only when a decision needs a person; (6) add wave tag, needs dependencies, correct phase (create one if none fits). Standard rule for this project and every ddflow-managed project.
data.title: Pre-file triage is the default for filing tasks and bugs

data.body: Extend the shipped ddflow rules so every managed project treats pre-file triage as the default when adding a task or bug: (1) check existing tasks/bugs for duplicates or closable overlaps; (2) check what is planned; (3) identify reusable/extensible core modules; (4) reuse prior research, never re-derive; (5) ask the operator only for person-decisions; (6) add wave tag + needs deps + correct phase (create one if none fits). Covers the duplicated-check part already in BL-no-duplicates; this loads the full checklist into the standard rule surface (help text + AGENTS.md rule block), with a parity test that the text ships. Tests first.
data.title: Ship pre-file triage as a standard rule for every ddflow-managed project
